sloka: नित्यं त्वं रामपार्श्वेषु वर्तसे पुरुषर्षभ ।कच्चिद्विनाकृतस्तेन द्विरात्रं शोकमागतः ।। ७.४६.२७ ॥
transliteration: nityaṁ tvaṁ rāmapārśveṣu vartase puruṣarṣabha ।kaccidvinākṛtastena dvirātraṁ śokamāgataḥ ।। 7.46.27 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, you are always by Rama's side; I hope you have not become sorrowful because you have been separated from him for two nights.
